semantic_fragments.content: RM RESULTS TABLE section 7.3.3 covers Batteries risk management. ISO 14971 clauses 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 6, and 7.3 are all addressed. Key requirements include: battery polarities and low voltage prompt requirements defined (5.2); hazards addressed (5.3); risks of each hazardous situation estimated (5.4); risks evaluated (6); verification/validation of risk reduction measures addressed (7.3). All verdicts: Pass.
RM RESULTS TABLE section 7.3.7 covers Supply terminals. Only ISO 14971 clause 5.3 is listed with no document reference and no remarks. Verdict: N/A.

RM RESULTS TABLE section 7.4.2 covers Control devices. ISO 14971 clauses 5.2 through 7.3 are all addressed via PT9L-FXPJ01 V1.0. Key notes: switches indicated by symbols (5.2); hazards addressed (5.3); risks estimated (5.4); risks evaluated (6); risk reduction verification addressed (7.2); battery polarities and low voltage prompt requirements defined (7.3). All verdicts: Pass.

RM RESULTS TABLE section 7.5 covers Safety Signs. ISO 14971 clauses 5.2 through 7.2 are addressed. Notes include: safety sign defined (5.2); all hazards associated with safety sign source identified (5.3); risks estimated (5.4); risk acceptability estimated and documented (6); risk control measures implemented and verification of effectiveness recorded (7.2). All verdicts: Pass.

RM RESULTS TABLE section 7.9.3.2 covers Replacement of fuses, power supply cords, and other parts. ISO 14971 clauses 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 6, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5 are listed but all document references and remarks are empty. Verdict: N/A.
RM RESULTS TABLE section 8.1b covers the fundamental rule of protection against electric shock, specifically related to accidental detachment of conductors and connectors. Verdict: Pass.
